---
title: "ssoossh ssh login"
description: "Authenticate via OIDC and load a signed SSH certificate into the agent (or files)."

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Generates a fresh keypair, sends the public key to the ssoossh server, opens the browser for OIDC approval, and waits over SSE for the signed certificate. Used from ssh_config's `Match exec`, or interactively before a session.

A certificate that is already loaded and still valid is reused rather than replaced, so one approval covers every connection until it expires. Pass --force to replace it with a new one.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh ssh login [flags] [args]
```

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--force` | bool | `false` | request a new certificate even if a valid one is already loaded |
| `--key-size` | int | `0` | ssh key size (bits for rsa, curve for ecdsa; ignored for ed25519) |
| `--key-type` | string |  | ssh key algorithm to generate: ed25519, ecdsa, or rsa (default depends on FIPS mode) |
| `--no-agent-forwarding` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-agent-forwarding extension |
| `--no-port-forwarding` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-port-forwarding extension |
| `--no-pty` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-pty extension |
| `--no-user-rc` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-user-rc extension |
| `--no-x11-forwarding` | bool | `false` | do not request permit-X11-forwarding extension |

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
